common.Control.new: needs project management: the studio serves the one project directory it was launched on (`eda board serve -C dir`) and has no verb to create a new project or document, so there is nothing for New to start
common.Control.open: needs project management: the studio serves one project directory chosen at launch and has no verb to open or switch to another project
common.Control.toggleGridOverrides: needs per-item-type grid overrides (the Edit Grids dialog's connected-items / wires / vias / text / graphics grids and category-aware snapping in the move, drag and route tools); the studio snaps every item to the one grid, so the toggle would switch off nothing. (Ctrl+Shift+G stays bound to Ungroup here; KiCad binds it to this action and leaves Ungroup unbound)
common.Interactive.pasteSpecial: nothing to special-case yet: its options are annotation handling for pasted footprints/symbols and clearing the nets of pasted copper, but the studio's clipboard holds no footprints or symbols (only tracks, vias, zones, shapes and text), every copper item must name a net, and the schematic has no copy/paste at all
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeImportedG: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.applyDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so no group can be linked to a block layout
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.barcode: needs barcode items (PCB_BARCODE: a barcode or QR code generated from text); the design IR has no barcode item or encoder and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.ddImportGraphi: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer (this is Import Graphics reached by dropping a file on the canvas); none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.drawTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeCharacter: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board characteristics as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeLinkedDes: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to link to a group or place
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placePoint: needs point items (PCB_POINT: reference/snap points stored on the board); the design IR has no point item and the snapping code knows no such anchor
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeReference: needs reference-image items (PCB_REFERENCE_IMAGE: a bitmap on a graphic layer, kept out of every output); the design IR has no image item
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeStackup: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board stackup as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.saveToLinkedDe: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no linked block to save a group to
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.textbox: needs text-box items (PCB_TEXTBOX: wrapped text in a bordered box); the design IR's Text is plain text with no box, border or wrapping
pcbnew.TableEditor.editTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.PadTool.explodePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.PadTool.recombinePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createGap: needs a free board footprint: the tool builds a footprint of its own (createBaseFootprint: two rectangular pads, no schematic part) and drops it on the board with doInteractiveItemPlacement, but every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createStub: needs a free board footprint: the tool builds a footprint of its own (createBaseFootprint: two rectangular pads, no schematic part) and drops it on the board with doInteractiveItemPlacement, but every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createStubArc: needs a free board footprint (every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one) and a custom-shape pad: the arc stub is one PAD_SHAPE::CUSTOM pad with a polygon primitive, and the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createFunctionShape: needs a free board footprint (every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one) and a custom-shape pad: createPolygonShape reads a shape-description file into one PAD_SHAPE::CUSTOM pad, and the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.MicrowaveTool.createLine: needs a free board footprint (every board part here comes from the design's schematic and no verb adds one) and the microwave inductor generator (microwave_inductor.cpp: the S/L meander built from arcs and segments, with its pattern dialog), which nothing here implements
pcbnew.ModuleEditor.createFootprint: needs the footprint wizards, which are Python scripts (FOOTPRINT_WIZARD_FRAME running pcbnew.FootprintWizardBase generators); the studio embeds no Python interpreter
pcbnew.ModuleEditor.checkFootprint: the Footprint Checker is a DRC run (DIALOG_FOOTPRINT_CHECKER over FOOTPRINT_CHECKER); DRC only runs through kicad-cli, which has no footprint-only check, and no DRC engine may be written here -- the board DRC reports the same problems for a placed footprint
pcbnew.Autoplacer.autoplaceOffboard: needs a second placement engine: KiCad's autoplacer (AR_AUTOPLACER, a routing-matrix cost search of about two thousand lines with its own cell and matrix model) is not part of this studio, whose placement is driven through `eda board` and judged by the placement gates, so footprints are not auto-placed behind those gates
pcbnew.Autoplacer.autoplaceSelected: needs a second placement engine: KiCad's autoplacer (AR_AUTOPLACER, a routing-matrix cost search of about two thousand lines with its own cell and matrix model) is not part of this studio, whose placement is driven through `eda board` and judged by the placement gates, so footprints are not auto-placed behind those gates
pcbnew.Generator.genCacnelEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to cancel
pcbnew.Generator.genFinishEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to finish
pcbnew.Generator.genRemove: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator to remove
pcbnew.Generator.genStartEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator to start editing
pcbnew.Generator.genUpdateEdit: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is no generator edit session to update
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateAll: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is nothing to rebuild
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateAllTuning: needs tuning-pattern generator items (PCB_TUNING_PATTERN); the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks and keeps no pattern to re-tune within its bounds
pcbnew.Generator.regenerateSelected: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so there is nothing to rebuild
pcbnew.Generator.showManager: needs generator items (PCB_GENERATOR: parametric items such as length-tuning patterns, kept editable and rebuilt from their stored parameters); the design IR has no generator item (the studio's length tuner writes plain tracks), so the Generators Manager would have nothing to list
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.changeFootprint: needs a per-instance footprint assignment: a placed footprint's library footprint comes from the frozen component intent, and the design IR's `FootprintInstance` holds only position, rotation, side and label side, so there is nothing an exchange could change (Edit Symbol Fields changes only the schematic symbol's Footprint field, which the board does not read)
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.changeFootprints: needs a per-instance footprint assignment: a placed footprint's library footprint comes from the frozen component intent, and the design IR's `FootprintInstance` holds only position, rotation, side and label side, so there is nothing an exchange could change (Edit Symbol Fields changes only the schematic symbol's Footprint field, which the board does not read)
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.migrate3DModels: needs the KiCad 3D model libraries on disk to scan for STEP replacements of VRML models (the dialog matches model names by edit distance against `${KICAD9_3DMODEL_DIR}`); the studio's footprints carry only a model path string and its 3D view draws procedural bodies, so there is no model file to look up or substitute
pcbnew.GlobalEdit.removeUnusedPads: needs per-layer pad copper (a padstack): the dialog strips the copper of through-hole pads and vias on inner layers that nothing connects to, while the design IR models a through-hole pad as copper on every layer, with nothing to take one layer away from
pcbnew.InteractiveEdit.swapGateNets: needs per-pad net overrides: pads are not selectable items and a pad's net comes from the schematic, while design.json stores no net per pad, so a net swapped on the board would have no place to live (the same change is made on the schematic by swapping the pins' connections)
pcbnew.InteractiveEdit.swapPadNets: needs per-pad net overrides: pads are not selectable items and a pad's net comes from the schematic, while design.json stores no net per pad, so a net swapped on the board would have no place to live (the same change is made on the schematic by swapping the pins' connections)
pcbnew.Picker.selectItemInteractively: an internal sub-tool with no menu entry or hotkey: KiCad runs it only when a dialog hands it a receiver (`RunAction( selectItemInteractively, params )`), bare it does nothing; the studio's dialogs call its port directly (actions/pcbPicker.ts: `pickItem`) from the Select Point / Select Item buttons of Position Relative and Create Array
pcbnew.Picker.selectPointInteractively: an internal sub-tool with no menu entry or hotkey: KiCad runs it only when a dialog hands it a receiver (`RunAction( selectPointInteractively, params )`), bare it does nothing; the studio's dialogs call its port directly (actions/pcbPicker.ts: `pickPoint`) from the Select Point / Select Item buttons of Position Relative and Create Array
eeschema.EditorControl.importGraphics: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
eeschema.SymbolDrawing.drawSymbolTextBox: needs text boxes (SCH_TEXTBOX with a border and fill, wrapped text); the library symbol IR has no text box graphic -- only rectangle, polyline, circle, arc and text
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.deriveFrom: needs derived symbols (a symbol that `extends` a parent and inherits its drawing and pins); the library symbol IR has no inheritance, so a derived symbol would have nothing to refer to
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.flattenSym: needs derived symbols: KiCad offers it only for a symbol that extends another (derivedSymbolSelectedCondition) and the library symbol IR has no inheritance (a derived symbol read from a file is flattened on import)
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.updateSymb: needs derived symbols: it re-syncs a symbol with its parent and KiCad itself only answers 'Symbol is not derived from another symbol.' for any other; the library symbol IR has no inheritance, and a handler that always says so would stand in for the missing subsystem
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.showRelate: needs derived symbols: it is offered only for a symbol that extends another or has children (relatedSymbolSelectedCondition), and the library symbol IR has no inheritance
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.showHidden: needs symbol fields on the canvas: the library symbol model keeps no field positions or visibility and the editor draws no fields, so there are no hidden fields to show
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.nextSymbol: belongs to the Symbol Viewer frame (toolbars_symbol_viewer.cpp: a read-only library browser with its own symbol list); the studio has no Symbol Viewer -- the editor's library tree is where symbols are browsed
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.previousSy: belongs to the Symbol Viewer frame (toolbars_symbol_viewer.cpp: a read-only library browser with its own symbol list); the studio has no Symbol Viewer -- the editor's library tree is where symbols are browsed
eeschema.SymbolLibraryControl.exportSymb: plots are kicad-cli's job (`kicad-cli sym export svg`); the studio has no route to it for one symbol and no plotter may be written here
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignB: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.autoplaceFields: needs per-instance symbol field positions (the schematic IR stores no field placement: reference and value are drawn at fixed offsets, so there is nothing to autoplace) and text metrics for the placement search

eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeLinkedD: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks) and the link from a group to its block; this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no linked block to place
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.saveToLinked: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks) and the link from a group to its block; this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to save the selection into
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.drawSheetFro: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematic blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to copy in as a sheet

needs the sheet-file import behind Import Sheet (this is the action it posts once a file is chosen): copy another schematic file into the project as a new sheet screen. Draw Sheet itself works (an empty sheet, or one that shares an existing sheet's screen)
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.importSheet: needs a file chooser and a sheet-file importer: the one reader there is (`import_kicad_sch`) builds a whole design, not a sheet of this one, and no verb merges the imported parts, nets and wires under this design's references and nets
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.drawTable: needs table items (SCH_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
eeschema.InteractiveDrawing.placeImage: needs bitmap items (SCH_BITMAP: an embedded PNG/JPEG with a scale) and a file chooser; the design IR has no image type, only vector shapes, text boxes and directive labels
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.assignNetclass: needs an edit command for net classes: they live on the board's constraints file, which the studio only reads (Board Setup > Net Classes is read-only), so the net-name pattern the dialog adds has nowhere to be stored
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.swapPinLabels: needs pin selection: the schematic canvas selects whole symbols, wires, labels and the like but never a single symbol pin (SCH_PIN_T), and the action swaps the net labels of the selected pins in selection order
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.swapPins: needs pin selection (the schematic canvas never selects a single symbol pin) and per-instance pin geometry: KiCad swaps the pins' positions in the symbol's own copy of its library pins, while a placed symbol here always reads its pins from the library symbol
eeschema.InteractiveEdit.toggleDeMorgan: needs per-symbol body styles: the engine symbol (SymbolGraphic / LibPin) has no body-style field and LibrarySymbol::to_engine_symbol drops the alternate style's items, so a placed symbol cannot show another style (web/studio/PARITY-symedit.md, Known gaps)
eeschema.InteractiveSelection.SyncSelect: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry that KiCad never runs as an action (cross-probing and the symbol fields table call SCH_SELECTION_TOOL::SyncSelection directly), so there is nothing a user could invoke
